summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/notifications@41.3.4 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes Bun to execute a locally-shipped 727,680-byte file `math_init.js` from the package root (`execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js path])`). math_init.js is fully obfuscated in obfuscator.io style — a string-array shifter (`WV8StW`), hex-numeric identifiers, a ~2000-entry mixed literal array (`n7gIxM`), and a custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — with no source form shipped. A React UI notifications library has no functional reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install and use it to run an opaque bundled script; the choice of Bun evades Node-based install-time scanners. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on every `npm install`, granting arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine with the contents of math_init.js undisclosed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
